annotations.title: Community help: free and low-cost services, in Spanish and English

description: The guide's bilingual community directory: free and low-cost services for people who live and work on the East End. Immigration legal advocacy, sliding-scale and no-status-asked clinics, food pantries, the winter shelter, tenant-rights and wage-theft hotlines, ESL / GED / citizenship classes, childcare and youth programs, money transfer, Spanish-language Mass times, the Latino markets, and the Sunday soccer leagues. Every record carries `phone`, `source`, `sourceUrl`, `lastVerified`, and the guide's own text in both languages (`description.es` / `description.en`). Two fields are computed rather than stored: `nextSpanishMass` / `nextEnglishMass`, the next service from now on the East End's clock (America/New_York), and `inSeasonNow` on the soccer leagues for this month. `offEastEnd: true` marks a referral to Bay Shore, Hempstead or Central Islip. A record states that a service is free, confidential or safe regarding immigration status only where the provider's own published words state it, and those words are quoted. `query` takes either language; `need` is a shortcut vocabulary. With no argument nothing is looked up and the answer lists the needs and towns covered. Returns up to 8. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

need.description: Shortcut category, when the question is plainly one of these.

query.description: The need, in the asker's words and either language, e.g. 'my boss hasn't paid me', 'clases de inglés', 'food pantry', 'misa en español', 'dentist', 'help with rent'.

town.description: A hamlet ('East Hampton', 'Riverhead') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.
